name: ai-notes-platform
description: A personal AI notes platform, built one phase at a time.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB,AI --prefix-colors green,blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:ai && npm run build
